quarantine_rule: Every supplied preset is provenance=user_full_sample_tpe. It may be replayed on the canonical engine as a labelled retrospective reference only. name_collisions_are_not_shared_presets: A dictionary name appearing in two files is two different parameter sets; identity is alpha_id + file sha + dictionary name + typed values digest (guide A.1).
